summary: No loop or output-length increase was reproduced in deterministic control, HiCache L2, or file-backed HiCache serving probes. The prepared source already contains current related correctness fixes, and no new source change is justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Created the deterministic random two-layer Llama fixture outside the worktree.

Actual HTTP server GPU execution for no-HiCache, L2, and file-backed HiCache. Each arm returned [32,32,32,32] completion tokens; repeated identical inputs had byte-identical outputs; HiCache repeated-prefix requests reported 120 cached tokens.
Boundary restart against 121 persisted file-backend pages. Generation stayed deterministic, but the first request reported zero cached tokens, so L3 restore was not claimed.

gpu_execution_evidence: Server logs identify AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 execution, real Triton compilation, GPU prefill/decode batches, and successful HTTP responses in all arms.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights, NVIDIA H20/CUDA, TP=4, reporter dataset, Mooncake service, RDMA, or multi-terabyte L3 environment were available. The tiny random Llama cannot establish semantic accuracy or qualify the reported DeepSeek-V4 Mooncake workload; file-backed L3 read attribution was not observed after restart.
